tool_input.command:
python3 -c "
import os; import google.cloud.bigquery as bq
c=bq.Client(project=os.environ['GCP_PROJECT'], location=os.environ['GCP_LOCATION'])
d=os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']+'.'+os.environ['GCP_BQ_DATASET']
q='\`'+d+'\`'
tgt=d+'.churntrainingcdae59'
sql=('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE \`'+tgt+'\` AS '
 'WITH lab AS (SELECT account_id,label_time,churned FROM '+q+'.labels), '
 'tx AS (SELECT l.account_id,l.label_time,t.amount,t.balance FROM lab l JOIN '+q+'.f_transactions t ON t.account_id=l.account_id AND t.event_time<=l.label_time QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id,l.label_time ORDER BY t.event_time DESC)=1), '
 'pr AS (SELECT l.account_id,l.label_time,p.credit_score,p.tier FROM lab l JOIN '+q+'.f_profiles p ON p.account_id=l.account_id AND p.event_time<=l.label_time QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id,l.label_time ORDER BY p.event_time DESC)=1), '
 'ac AS (SELECT l.account_id,l.label_time,a.sessions_7d FROM lab l JOIN '+q+'.f_activity a ON a.account_id=l.account_id AND a.event_time<=l.label_time QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id,l.label_time ORDER BY a.event_time DESC)=1), '
 'hh AS (SELECT l.account_id,l.label_time,h.health_score FROM lab l JOIN '+q+'.f_account_health h ON h.account_id=l.account_id AND h.event_time<=l.label_time QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id,l.label_time ORDER BY h.event_time DESC)=1) '
 'SELECT lab.account_id,lab.label_time,tx.amount,tx.balance,pr.credit_score,pr.tier,ac.sessions_7d,hh.health_score,lab.churned '
 'FROM lab LEFT JOIN tx USING(account_id,label_time) LEFT JOIN pr USING(account_id,label_time) LEFT JOIN ac USING(account_id,label_time) LEFT JOIN hh USING(account_id,label_time)')
c.query(sql).result(); t=c.get_table(tgt); print('rows',t.num_rows); print('cols',[f.name for f in t.schema])
"
